## Checklist (from the Definition of Done)

- [ ] Code is complete, with no placeholders
- [ ] Owner tag is the first line of every new code file
- [ ] Names are full and readable, files under 300 lines, one job per file
- [ ] Tests written and passing, with a recorded run
- [ ] No secrets in code
- [ ] No em dashes anywhere
- [ ] For AI output: schema validation, confidence and source link present
- [ ] Documentation and the tracker are updated
- [ ] Audit records written where needed

## Change control

- [ ] This is not a significant change, or a change request is linked
- [ ] Database change: migration included and rollback tested (or not applicable)
- [ ] Financial calculation impact: none, or described and tested
